question.problem: Find the angle between $a=⟨4,-3,2⟩$ and $b=⟨3,4,1⟩.$ Round your answer to $2$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Rearranging the dot product formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,a\,||\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{4\cdot 3+(-3)\cdot 4+2\cdot 1}{\sqrt{{4}^{2}+(-3)^{2}+{2}^{2}}\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{4}^{2}+{1}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{2}{\sqrt{29}\cdot \sqrt{26}} \\  & =\frac{2}{\sqrt{754}}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arccos}⁡(\frac{2}{\sqrt{754}})≈{85.82}^{∘}.
$$
